attributes.title: DDNA 35th Annual Education Conference
attributes.summary:
The Developmental Disabilities Nurses Association holds its 35th Annual Education Conference from April 23 to 26, 2027, at the Loews Kansas City Hotel in downtown Kansas City, Missouri. It serves nurses who care for people with intellectual and developmental disabilities in group homes, state programs, schools, clinics and community agencies.

Attendees who go to all sessions and complete the evaluations can earn more than 20 nursing CE hours, with extra hours at some sponsored sessions. DDNA's certification exam is also given at the conference: the application deadline is February 22, 2027, and exam registration for approved applicants closes March 25, 2027.

Registration fees were listed as coming soon when we checked. The hotel booking link is provided after you finish conference registration.
